description:
Get the full announcement for one Grants.gov opportunity: summary, eligibility, award ceiling/floor, total funding, expected number of awards, cost sharing, key dates, and agency contact.

Use grants_search_opportunities first to find the numeric opportunity ID.

opportunity_id.description: Numeric opportunity ID from search results, e.g. 359145

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: grants_get_opportunity
title: Get Grant Opportunity Details
